engine.status: FROZEN — this lane changes ALLOCATION only; no engine parameter may move

validation.bootstrapDisclosureRequired: the terminal card must report BOTH the sealed moving-block-20 p95 AND the IID p95 on the same realized curve; the breaker binds on the moving-block figure only
validation.bootstrapDisclosureImplementation: the disclosed IID p95 is the SAME bootstrapTradeOutcomes call on the SAME realized book-day return series with the SAME seed and the SAME resample count, at blockLength 1 (a moving block of length 1 IS iid resampling with replacement). It is rendered as an explicitly NON-BINDING line and may never enter any pass/fail predicate; mcMaxDDWithinBreaker continues to read the moving-block-20 figure only.

plateau.rule: all 9 cells are computed INSIDE the single terminal evaluation; the sealed centre cell is the only cell that gates admission, so the other 8 can only FAIL the run (profit-plateau instability), never rescue it — no selection occurs and condition (f) holds

hypothesis.mechanism: fast weekly momentum (63/2/top-5) produces a real, additive return stream whose ONLY disqualifying defect at full weight is tail depth; because Sharpe is scale-invariant and a non-interest-bearing cash reserve has zero volatility and zero correlation, a fixed 30% allocation to the frozen engine transports the engine's whole risk-adjusted return through the 30% Monte Carlo p95 drawdown breaker without changing one engine parameter
hypothesis.causalThesis: the strategist's INVERSION: the six-strategy inverse-volatility stabiliser, not fast momentum, was the binding drawdown constraint (its OWN MC p95 is 29.12%, 0.88pp under the breaker, so it absorbed only 7.89% fast momentum). Removing the stabiliser's tail — not shrinking the engine — is what buys capacity: cash-only admits 38.72% at the same breaker with HIGHER CAGR (20.14% vs 16.40%) AND higher Sharpe (1.2605 vs 1.165) than the best risky stabiliser
hypothesis.sharpeDerivation: worst contiguous multi-year sub-sample 0.958 (1,152 sessions, contains 2020 and 2022 in full) MINUS QDR-10's own measured 2026-survivor-sleeve contribution of ~0.16, which sub-sampling is structurally blind to because every sub-sample uses the identical 2026-fixed sleeve. NOT the fitted 1.15-1.26, which was selected over six stabilisers on one window
hypothesis.predictedCagr: 12-16% net at the sealed 30% weight; strictly lower than the engine's unlevered figure and not a claim about the engine
hypothesis.predictedOosDsr: greater-than-0.950 at annualized Sharpe 0.80 over 487 five-session observations (predicted 0.99336)
hypothesis.powerNote: Powered as a confirmatory (N=1) test at 80.0%: required annualized Sharpe at 487 observations is 0.5292, the declared 0.80 exceeds it by 0.271, and Phi(0.80*sqrt(9.663) - 1.6449) = 0.800. The long window is deliberate: at the honest 0.80 a 4.3-year window is a 50% coin flip, which QDR-10 already refused by name. If any of the six structural confirmatory conditions fails, the lane deflates to 117 exploratory trials, where the declared effect size is unreachable inside any realistic window: such a run must close INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, not as evidence against the hypothesis.
falsification: REJECTED if OOS DSR <= 0.95 at N=1 over the 487 sealed observations (realized annualized Sharpe below 0.5292)
REJECTED if the moving-block-20 book-day MC p95 max drawdown exceeds 0.30 at the realized path length — this is the direct falsification of the cash-transport thesis
REJECTED if risk of ruin exceeds 0.05
PLATEAU_INSTABILITY if any of the 9 allocation cells fails the profit-plateau check
INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (never evidence against the mechanism) if fewer than 487 post-boundary observations exist, or if any of the six confirmatory conditions fails
hypothesis.pathLengthNote: MC p95 rises with path length: the same 38.72% cash book measures 30.00% at 1,646 sessions, 31.48% at 2,145, 32.67% at 2,520 (~+6.5pp per natural-log unit of length). At the reserved 2,435 sessions the 38.72% book would measure ~32.5% and BREACH; the sealed 30% weight is set to hold ~25.2% at that length, 4.8pp of headroom. The weight is frozen ex ante and may not be re-solved after the path is observed.

windowBinding.binds: an explicit calendar from/to pair INSIDE config.runConfig, and therefore inside configHash. No "period" key may appear in runConfig and no --period flag may be supplied at the terminal run.
windowBinding.periodPresetForbidden: a --period preset resolves `to` against latestTradingDate at RUN time (src/quant/backtest/runLab.ts resolvePeriodDates), so the window would float with whenever the run is launched — that IS window selection after seeing data. Forbidden for every CONFIRMATORY lane. As a consequence FULL_PERIOD_START (2018-01-02) is never consulted by this lane and does not cap it.
windowBinding.fromDerivation: 2026-09-08. QDR-16 sets the FLOOR ("the first NYSE regular session strictly after the calendar date of sealedAt"); this seal takes a deliberate, disclosed margin ABOVE that floor rather than the minimum, because the seal commit's time BECOMES sealedAt and a from that lands even one day before it would fail QDR-9 condition (d) and deflate the lane to EXPLORATORY-117, where the declared 0.80 is unreachable. The mechanical rule used: the first NYSE regular session strictly after US Labor Day 2026 (2026-09-07). Authored 2026-08-19, so the margin is 20 calendar days / 12 intervening NYSE sessions. A LATER from strictly strengthens condition (d) (a wider seal-to-boundary gap) and can bias nothing, because no data for any of these dates exists at seal. If the seal commit does not land strictly before 2026-09-08T00:00:00-04:00 this manifest MUST be re-authored with a new from and NOT committed as-is.
windowBinding.toDerivation: 2036-06-24, the calendar date of the (2435+25)=2460th projected NYSE regular session counting from (inclusive) 2026-09-08 as session 1, computed from the deterministic NYSE holiday rules (New Year's Day with the NYSE Saturday non-observance, MLK 3rd Mon Jan, Washington 3rd Mon Feb, Good Friday by Gregorian computus, Memorial last Mon May, Juneteenth, Independence, Labor 1st Mon Sep, Thanksgiving 4th Thu Nov, Christmas; Sat->preceding Fri, Sun->following Mon). Span 3,577 calendar days = 9.7933 years at 251.19 sessions/yr. The 2,435th required session projects to 2036-05-16; the remaining 25 are the disclosed closure pad. Scheduled half-days are regular sessions and are counted; unscheduled closures are unprojectable by construction and are exactly what the pad insures.
windowBinding.padDisclosure: the 25-session pad insures ONLY against unscheduled closures (a 9/11- or Sandy-class event) making the sealed window fall short of 2,435 sessions and forcing a spurious INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE. If no such closure occurs the window yields ~492 observations against the sealed 487 floor; that surplus is fixed at seal, is not selectable afterwards, and moves attainable DSR by under 1%. Disclosed, not hidden.
windowBinding.cliInvocation: npm run backtest -- --manifest docs/quant-experiments/halal-fast-momentum-cash-core-v1.json --runner <identity> --setup halal-fast-momentum-cash-core --from 2026-09-08 --to 2036-06-24 --universe halal --seed 42 --oos 1 --engine shared --feed yahoo-daily --source db
windowBinding.auditorRecomputes: (d) config.runConfig.from is strictly after the out-of-band `sealedAt`; (e) every terminal observation lies inside [from, to]; (a) stableConfigHash(config) === configHash proves the pair has not moved since seal; and config.evidenceBoundary names the same date as config.runConfig.from. Absence of `sealedAt` fails closed to EXPLORATORY exactly as QDR-9 already rules.
windowBinding.marginDisclosure: from is NOT the minimum QDR-16 date but the first session after Labor Day 2026, a 20-calendar-day margin over the authoring date. Disclosed here, inside configHash, so the choice is ex-ante and unselectable afterwards. It costs the lane nothing: the window length is fixed at 2,460 sessions regardless of where it starts.
